name: Rauzy Fractal Tiling
desc: The Tribonacci Rauzy fractal — a jagged three-lobed quasicrystalline region tiled by three self-similar copies of itself in magenta, teal and gold, slowly rotating and re-colouring as the aperiodic mosaic breathes.

density.doc: fractal fill richness / substitution point count (rebuilds)

scale.doc: mosaic size vs frame (higher = bigger, overfills)

hue.doc: base palette hue (magenta anchor for the three lobes)
